result:
Ahora tengo lo necesario. Propongo la edición: importar `AppState` (ya usado en otros archivos del mismo paquete sin acoplamiento, ver `appStateTypes.ts`) y afirmar el valor en la frontera donde `hooks/appState.ts` erosiona el tipo a `unknown` deliberadamente.

```json
{"file": "src/packages/tool-registry/src/tools/BashTool/UI.tsx",
 "edits": [
   {"old": "import type { Tool } from '../../Tool.js'\nimport { backgroundAll } from '@thyrox/agent/tasks/LocalShellTask.js'",
    "new": "import type { Tool } from '../../Tool.js'\nimport type { AppState } from '@thyrox/app-host/state/AppState.js'\nimport { backgroundAll } from '@thyrox/agent/tasks/LocalShellTask.js'"},
   {"old": "    backgroundAll(() => store.getState(), setAppState)",
    "new": "    backgroundAll(() => store.getState() as AppState, setAppState)"}
 ],
 "patterns": [
   {"patron": "app-state-store-unknown-boundary",
    "senal_del_verificador": "TS2322.*Type 'unknown' is not assignable to type 'AppState'",
    "fix_generico": "hooks/appState.ts expone `Store<unknown>` a propósito (host binding que evita acoplar tool-registry a src/state/AppState).
```
